name: following-pointer
title: Custom Cursor Follower
description: A rounded article card with a bright gradient banner, a tag, a heading, body copy and an author line. On hover the normal pointer becomes a small arrow carrying a randomly coloured call-to-action label.
use: A link card should feel alive and advertise its call to action right at the pointer.
avoid: Touch or keyboard users need the card's action, or the label must always be legible.
a11y: The follower and its label are pointer-only with no keyboard route, and the coloured pill can leave white text on pale grey. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded card with a vivid violet-to-green gradient panel across the top and a dark body below holding an outlined tag, a bold heading, two lines of grey copy and a small orange-pink avatar beside author text. On hover a tiny arrow cursor and a rounded coloured label hang at the pointer.
behaves: Entering the card hides the native cursor and spawns a small arrow with a coloured pill label that appears at the pointer and follows every move. Leaving shrinks both away and brings the normal cursor back.
customise: children fill the card, title sets the label's text and className restyles the wrapper. The arrow icon, the random colour palette and the fade are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One card plus a single pointer element that exists only while hovered.
